entries.02b5d76f3e8c6a29: This field handles materials for a wide range of industrial applications, including industrial catalysts, structural components, refractories, brake materials, brazing and surface treatment. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥7,870 million. They are used in chemical synthesis catalysts, continuous casting nozzles, brake pads and others.

entries.26eb424194b0281c: This strategic field handles materials for healthcare, including biomaterials such as dental materials, medical devices, antibacterial agents and adsorbents. entries.4a60bfdd6b808143: This is a strategic field handling materials for energy applications, such as energy catalysts, secondary batteries and SOFC/SOEC. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,686 million. They are used in hydrogen-related catalysts, additives for lithium-ion battery cathode materials, solid electrolytes, and components for water electrolysis.
entries.5134683f08863f9e: This is a strategic field handling materials for electronic components, electronic substrates and ferrules, optics, and semiconductors. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,618 million. They are used in multilayer ceramic capacitors, semiconductor polishing, anti-reflection films for displays, and refractive index adjustment of camera lenses.
entries.86dc8e5095bd9240: This field handles ceria-zirconia composite oxides for automotive exhaust purification catalysts, materials for oxygen sensors, and others. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥22,424 million, the largest field by application. They are used in three-way catalysts, GPF, oxidation catalysts, solid electrolytes, spark plugs, and others.
entries.94a03f2fe635740d: Headquartered in Kitahama, Chuo-ku, Osaka, the company is a zirconium compound manufacturer consisting of the company, five subsidiaries and three affiliates. It is a single segment that manufactures and sells zirconium compounds, centered on zirconium oxide, and the consolidated number of employees as of the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 709. It has facilities for both dry and wet processes, and under the wet process carries out integrated production from ore to final product.
